vignette_provenance.note: These vignettes were not written by humans and were not collected from patients. They were generated for this evaluation. Conditions C and D are author constructed approximations of dialect morphosyntax and lexicon, not speech recorded from speakers of that variety. Any result broken out by condition C or D describes the response to constructed text, not to how any real community speaks.
